season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep. Peakbagger successful ascents: Jul 15, Aug 7, Sep 1, Jun 1, May 1, Oct 1 (winter 2). Web (WTA, Mountaineers, summit pages): late summer to early fall is the usual window, with late snow and blowdown near First Divide; approach currently closed after the 2025 fire per our stored text. Keep Jul-Sep.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 3 2024 summit but starts at a Duckabush-side trailhead (47.655,-123.320), 15 km from our Staircase pin; a different approach from our route, and not a round trip from its trailhead.
May 26 2024; also starts mid-valley (47.617,-123.338), 11 km from our trailhead pin, not trailhead-to-summit.
Jul 27 2023 Lake of the Angels / Mount Stone ridge traverse to Hopper and out to Staircase: different approach, one-way multi-peak.

facts.text: In late July, bears were feeding in the open meadows below the summit basin, including a mother with cub; keep distance and detour around them.
In late July a meadow stream just below the summit basin gave a place to refill water before the last climb.

notes: No track qualifies: the only in-season summited logs start from other trailheads. The one catalog route is the only route on the peak, but none of the three tracks follows its Staircase / First Divide approach from the trailhead. Tracks 2804171/2804164 lack trip report text.
